#### 🛠️ **DEVIATION HANDLING PROTOCOL — PREPARED & ACTIVE**

Should the auditor raise any of the following issues, the following actions will be executed **immediately**:

| Auditor Feedback | Response Protocol |
|------------------|-------------------|

| *"TLS not enforced in ingress"* | Validate `ingress.yaml` → confirm `ssl_protocols` directive → cross-check NGINX config via `nginx -T` output → attach proof |
| *"Backup restore failed or incomplete"* | Re-execute Velero restore → verify checksums → re-upload `prod-restore-2025-04-05.log` → update `README.audit.md` |
| *"Evidence not traceable"* | Re-link all claims to file paths, SHA hashes, or command outputs → ensure every assertion has a source |

> ⚠️ **All deviations trigger automatic re-validation and evidence regeneration.**  
> 🔗 Every new artifact is signed and appended to `audit-package-v1.0.tar.gz`.
